paper.title: Improving Performance with Fast Alphas: A Tactical Overlay for Intraday Trend Trading
paper.implementation_ambiguity: The paper waits for a single opposite 5-minute bar and explicitly leaves urgency controls / forced execution windows outside scope. No maximum wait is invented in this campaign.

bar_construction.session_gap_policy: Runs reset at each session boundary, any missing aggregate interval, zero-return bar, or contract transition.
bar_construction.aggregation: left-closed/right-open intervals anchored at session start; open=first, high=max, low=min, close=last, volume=sum
bar_construction.empty_interval_policy: Do not forward-fill an interval containing no trades.
bar_construction.completed_bar_observability: A bar [t,t+5m) is observable at t+5m; the earliest executable timestamp is the open of the next one-minute bar at t+5m.

statistics.first_second_half_rule: split at the median unique eligible session date for each instrument
statistics.session_decomposition: three equal clock-time thirds of the frozen session
statistics.one_tick_perturbation: adverse/favorable perturbation of one tick at both next-bar open and close (two ticks round trip)

gate_1.study_passes_if: at least one of MNQ or MGC passes all frozen criteria

overlay.earliest_fill: open of the first one-minute bar after the qualifying 5-minute bar is complete
overlay.timeout_policy: No executable forced-timeout replay. If Gate 1 passes, begin with an event study and classify signals whose original exit precedes a qualifying bar as unfilled.
